General privileges, however, even over immovables, are
not subject to publication nor do they give a right of
tracing the property into the hands of subsequent
holders. Privileges over immovables securing sums due
to the State Treasury are also not subject to publication.
All these privileges rank prior to any other privilege over
immovables or mortgages, whatever may be the date of
their inscription. As between each other, the privilege
securing sums due to the State Treasury ranks prior to
general privileges.

الشهر ولا يثبت فيها حق التتبع ، ولا حاجة للشهر أيضا فى حقوق الامتياز
العقارية الضامنة لمبالغ مستحقة للخزانة العامة . وهذه الحقوق الممتازة

للمبالغ المستحقة للخزانة تقدم على حقوق الامتياز العامة.

blocks.text_en:
Provisions applying to the loss or deterioration of
mortgaged property apply also to privileges.
blocks.text_ar:
يسرى على الامتياز ما يسرى على الرهن الرسمى من أحكام متعلقة بهلاك
الشيء أو تلفه.

blocks.text_en:
In the absence of a provision of the law to the contrary,
privileges are extinguished in the same way and in
accordance with the same rules as a mortgage or a
pledge.
blocks.text_ar:
ينقضي حق الامتياز بنفس الطرق التي ينقضي بها حق الرهن الرسمى
وحق الرهن الحيازة ووفقا لأحكام انقضاء هذين الحقين ، ما لم يوجد نص
خاص يقضى بغير ذلك.

blocks.text_en:
In addition to the privileges established by special
provisions of the law, the rights enumerated in the
following articles are privileged.
blocks.text_ar:
الحقوق المبينة في المواد الآتية تكون ممتازة إلى جانب حقوق الامتياز
المقررة بنصوص خاصة.

blocks.title_en:
General Privileges and Special Privileges over
Movables
blocks.title_ar: حقوق الامتياز العامة وحقوق الامتياز الخاصة الواقعة على منقول

blocks.text_en:
Costs of legal proceedings incurred in the common
interest of all the creditors, for the preservation and the
sale of the property of the debtor, have a privilege over
the price of such property.
Such costs are payable in priority to any other claim,
whether privileged or secured by a mortgage, including
claims of creditors for whose benefit such costs have
been incurred. Costs incurred for the sale of the property
are payable in priority to the costs of the procedure of
distribution.

blocks.text_en:
Sums due to the State Treasury for taxes, duties and
other dues of any kind are privileged in accordance with
conditions laid down by laws and regulations issued in
this connection.
Such sums shall be paid out of the proceeds of sale of
the property charged with this privilege, in whosoever's
hands it may be, and before all other rights, whether
privileged or secured by a mortgage, except costs of legal
proceedings.
blocks.text_ar:

أى نوع كان ، يكون لها امتياز بالشروط المقررة فى القوانين والأوامر
الصادرة فى هذا الشأن.
( ٢ ) وتستوفى هذه المبالغ من ثمن الأموال المثقلة بهذا الامتياز فى أية يد
كانت قبل أى حق آخر ، ولو كان ممتازا أو مضمونا برهن رسمي عدا
المصروفات القضائية.
